#Question 1

f <- function(x) ifelse(x >= 2, exp(-3*(x - 2)) + exp(-(x - 30)**2) + exp(-(x - 20)**2/0.01), 0)

##(a)

#Metropolis-Hasting Algorithm for random walk
mh <- function(x0,fun,rq,sg){ 
  n <- 1e4 
  xall <- rep(NA,n+1) 
  x <- x0 
  xall[1] <- x
  
  
  for (t in seq(2,n+1)){ 
    x <- x 
    y <- rq(x,sg) 
    
    if (runif(1)<=(fun(y))/(fun(x))){ 
      x<-y }  
    xall[t] <- x 
    } 
  
  return(xall) 
  }
set.seed(434)
run_chain <- function(sg){
  rq <- function(x, sg) rnorm(1, mean = x, sd = sg)
  MC <- mh(2, f, rq, sg)
  MC
}
sigma <- c(0.1, 1, 10, 100)
random_walk_mh <- sapply(sigma, run_chain)
plot(random_walk_mh[,1], type="l", ylim=c(2,50))
lines(random_walk_mh[,2], col='red')
lines(random_walk_mh[,3], col='green')
lines(random_walk_mh[,4], col='blue')

  }
